purpose: Make the outcome-blind Stage-3 feature artifact explicit enough for hierarchical realism calibration and downstream provenance binding.

row_populations.linked: One row per admissible E2 linked relation.
row_populations.control: One row per frozen matched control relation.
row_populations.requirement: Every row carries population=LINKED or CONTROL. This flag is structural provenance only and may not contain a correspondence value.

required_columns.promoter_key: Stable promoter-anchor identifier shared across all linked/control rows for the same promoter.
required_columns.source_hg19_distance_bp: Primary distance in source hg19 coordinates
required_columns.promoter_degree: Real E2 linked-edge count for this promoter; repeated across rows but defined once per promoter
required_columns.promoter_activity: Outcome-blind real promoter/gene activity summary as prospectively defined by Stage-3; repeated across rows
required_columns.re_density: Consensus-peak count in frozen local window
required_columns.rna_depth_sensitivity: If emitted, must name the exact statistic and units; current slope mapping is not commensurable with historical synthetic sensitivity
required_columns.atac_depth_sensitivity: If emitted, must name the exact statistic and units; current slope mapping is not commensurable with historical synthetic sensitivity

hierarchy_rules: promoter_degree must be constant within promoter_key
promoter_activity must be constant within promoter_key for the artifact's declared aggregation level
linked/control populations must be separately countable and reconciled
no promoter hierarchy may be inferred from shuffled feature values
forbidden_columns_or_payloads: per-edge Pearson/Spearman between E2 gene RNA and linked distal ATAC

emitted_artifacts.primary: NPZ or parquet/table with exact row order and the required structural columns
emitted_artifacts.receipt: JSON binding SHA-256 of the feature artifact, producer source SHA-256/git blob, authenticated NIH-CARD byte receipts, pairing closeout receipt, E2 digest, row counts, promoter counts, linked/control counts, and all drop reasons.
hierarchical_views: promoter table: one row per promoter_key
edge table: one row per pair_key with promoter_index
mapping: promoter_index for every edge row

validation: artifact SHA-256 recorded before realism calibration
